decisions.reason: 무렵 is “around”; “in” drops that approximation.
Negative “or” is natural English; “new” is unsupported and 잽싸게 is ongoing rush.
decisions.replacement: The old wooden door creaked, but no one inside turned to look. Not even the owner or the waiter, who should have been rushing to greet a customer.

decisions.reason: Repeated 그래서 is the crowd’s impatient stutter; SOL drops it.
“Go on” and “continue” are equal; no gain.
그에 비해 is contrast, not a meanwhile aside.
Adds the spoken subject the crowd-directed 들으쇼 needs in English.
이러시오 is “acting like this,” not a generic “doing this.”
방금 is “just”; SOL drops it.
밀려났다 is shoved back/aside, not forward.
내려놨다 is setting the ass back down; 비위 is a turned stomach, not a soured mood.
돈을 줘야 한다 is the crowd’s obligation, and 그 순간이었다 is the interrupted “when—”.
Extra “Then—” doubles the beat already in BASE’s “when—”.
통도 크네 is a big spender; “threw this” is an unsupported inference.
Puts the wife as the one beating him, matching 마누라한테 맞아 죽을.
그때 marks the moment; SOL deletes it.
감싼 is wrapped around, not merely covering.
“Say it aloud” naturalizes 말을 보태지 않아도 without changing the inference.
Hair’s-breadth is idiomatically right; “gut” over-specifies 칼 맞아.
decisions.replacement: In his experience, there was only a hair’s breadth between a ruffian and a martial artist. He was an old man who had lived his share of years, but he had no desire to get stabbed to death in a place like this.

decisions.reason: 해당했다 is narrator fact, not appearance.
간단하게 is “simple,” reused later; “brief” is a needless swap.
무공을 배운 is learned, and “couldn’t afford” adds motive.
“Every last bit” is the more natural 싹 다.
SOL inserts an unstated “Wait.”
The source comma in 산서, 뭐? should stay.
“Of course” is added; 가장 is already “biggest.”
그 is “that”; 연관 is “related.”
한동안 침묵을 지키던 is prior silence, not a fresh pause.
Keeps 간단하게 as “simple” and the hedged “I believe I asked.”
English sigh-line reads cleaner with the man as subject.
“Was already dead” plus “heir” for 후계자 is cleaner without changing facts.
쳐들어왔 is stormed; 배회 is circling, not lurking.
통 큰 stays “big-spending”; 박아 넣는 is drive into, not bury.
군말 없이 자리에서 is without a word, from his seat—not without complaint.
이야기 잘 들었소 is curt acknowledgment, not thanks.
술을 들이켰고 is people drinking, not wine flowing.
입을 모아 is everyone joining in the talk.
문무 is civil and martial arts; 이번에 is “this time,” not “this battle.”
Bare alias matches the shouted 진천검?
나올까 말까 is the “if that” hedge.
굳게 is “firmly”; “rode on” adds onward.
decisions.replacement: Even as the drinking continued inside the inn, the man rode in silence. His mouth was firmly shut, but his ears were wide open.

decisions.reason: 또 산서잠룡인가 is “again,” not a padded full-title recap.
일급 정보 is grade-one intel, not generic top-grade.
호들갑 is fuss, not “what’s so special.”
라는 is hearsay: “supposed to be a Peak master.”
더 놀라운 건 is “even more surprising,” not “wilder.”
The two 단어 are names; “endless chatter” keeps 끊이지 않는 대화.
눈덩이처럼 불어나 크기를 키웠다 is the doubled snowball image.
천무지체 is a heaven-bestowed martial physique; “perfect” is extra.
산 자만 들어도 needs “hearing so much as”; “onward” is extra.
decisions.replacement: The man in the bamboo hat spurred his horse. Hearing so much as the *Shan* in Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi made his stomach churn and his head ache, as if he had taken an internal injury.

decisions.reason: 다음 날 아침 is “next morning”; no improvement.
오랜만이군 is a full thought: “It’s been a while.”
여전했다 is unchanged, not “as he remembered.”
굳이 변화가 있다면 is a change worth mentioning.
상태가 안 좋아 보이는 놈 is a guy who looks like hell, not “unwell.”
Keeps 물결 as water and the two-beat 잔잔하게, 그리고.
흘러나온 is emerged; 본래 있어야 할 자리 is its rightful place.
Binding 경지 as realm; SOL drops it.
들으며 is while listening, not as it sounded.
분명 and “definitely” are a wash.
Keeps the waited-for notification as a separate one.
이나 좀 captures the “at least bumped” complaint.
사용할 수 있게 된 is becoming able to use; 습관처럼 is habit; 제자리걸음 is going nowhere.
내가 익힌 must stay; SOL deletes it.
축적 속도가 더럽게 느리다는 is terrible speed, not a snail metaphor.
만나면 is running into an enemy, not “ever faced.”
무위를 직접 겪으면서 is tasting his martial might firsthand.
대단했지 is “incredible,” not the vaguer “something else.”
닷새가 지난 지금에도 is even after five days.
Spoken correction of 닷새가 아니라 lands as “Forget five days.”
잊지 못할 is never forget, not still remember.
“Swept across the battlefield” is the natural 휩쓸던.
버틸 수 있었을까 is “could I have lasted.”
1분 is a minute; “full” intensifies.
박아 넣을 수 있었다 is ability to drive the spear through, not a participle of permission.
Narrator contraction matches the surrounding voice.
크으 is the sound alone; “yeah” is added.
지만 is contrast: never got tired of it.
목숨을 건 도박인 만큼 빵빵했다 is stacked because it was a life gamble.
접어들었으며 is Fame entering triple digits.
전국구/지역구/침 좀 뱉는 is district-level clout, not celebrity/home-turf slang.
좋은 칭호 is a good title, not merely useful; 시원 is “as good as” the tooth-pull.
The contract line is recalled 말, not set-off dialogue.
Removing the invented quote matches the Korean presentation.
겠지만…사실로 만들었다 is bluff versus making it real in one beat.
강해져서 돌아간다 is get strong, then go back.
얻어서 돌아갈 is return carrying that power.
모조리 is the clipped “all of it.”
금의환향 is return home in glory, not a generic triumphant return.
아니, 잠깐만 is “No, wait.”
것 같은데 is “felt like I was forgetting.”
모든 걸 멈추고 is stopped everything, not a trimmed “what I was doing.”
여기냐 arriving at a gate is “Is this the place?”
알아차린 is recognizing the voice as Hyuk Mujin’s.
뜯겨 나갔다 is passive: ripped off.
흡연 구역 is the smoking area; “designated” is extra.
혼자 쓰는 방 is a room a man uses alone.
사형이다 is the joke verdict “got the death penalty.”
가중 처벌 is an aggravating offense in that sentencing gag.
점잖게 is politely, not “perfect courtesy.”
동그랗게 is round; 일하다 needs “working.”
decisions.replacement: The bastard’s eyes went round. His face was black with grime, as if he had spent twenty years working in the Aoji Coal Mine.[^1]

decisions.reason: Matches the clipped 젊은 나이에 초라한 행색 beat.
명성을 듣고 is hearing the fame.
비슷한 표정을 짓고 있는 is wearing a similar expression.
그대로 얼어붙었다 is froze solid.
한 번 보고 is looked once.
떨리는 마음으로 is a trembling heart, not pounding.
잠시만 is natural as “hold on a second.”
드러났다 after the blackened sleeve is the face under the grime; familiar/wash-up face is intact.
붕어빵이네 is the observation “carbon copies,” not “we’re.”
허허 is the missing chuckle.
웃어 보였다 is an awkward smile; 얼음장 같은 시선 is icy glare.
